# links

## `HostOf`

Returns the host part of a link such as `https://host/path`.

It is called for every request of the link service, so it must not allocate more than necessary.

prompt: pprof for the link service points at `HostOf` in `links/ops.go`: tons of short-lived garbage per call. Returns the host part of a link such as `https://host/path`. Rewrite it so it allocates (almost) nothing beyond its result. Do not change the signature or the output.

## `Offsets`

Returns the first n offset values.

It is called for every request of the offset service, so it must not allocate more than necessary.

prompt: `Offsets` in `offsets/ops.go` sits on a hot path (called millions of times per hour) and the profiler says most of the time goes into allocation and garbage collection. Returns the first n offset values. Reduce its allocations without changing what it returns; the behaviour tests stay the same.
